title: COBOL Compile & Execute on MVS
description: Create a COBOL program, write JCL, submit the compile-link-go job. Trace the deferred execution model.
deprecation_reason: Uses IGYWCL/SDSF/ISPF which don't exist on TK5. Use cobol-compile-run instead which uses COBUCG/QUEUE/RPF.

steps.title: This Lab Has Been Replaced
steps.screen:
NOTICE: This lab used Enterprise COBOL (IGYWCL) and SDSF
which are not available on MVS 3.8j / TK5.

Please use the 'COBOL Compile & Run on MVS' lab instead.
It uses the correct TK5 procedures:

  - RPF (editor) instead of ISPF
  - COBUCG (procedure) instead of IGYWCL
  - QUEUE (job output) instead of SDSF

The replacement lab includes:
  - Step-by-step RPF editor commands
  - Detailed JCL explanation
  - QUEUE job status commands
  - Mental models for each concept
steps.expected: Navigate to the cobol-compile-run lab for TK5-compatible COBOL development.
steps.hint: Select 'COBOL Compile & Run on MVS' from the lab list.
